CREATE TABLE pc_context_prepare_diagnostics (
	record_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	duration_ms FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	principal_type VARCHAR(16), 
	principal_id VARCHAR(255), 
	request_id VARCHAR(128), 
	trace_id VARCHAR(64), 
	query_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	requested_max_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_bytes BIGINT, 
	selected_count INTEGER, 
	error_code VARCHAR(64), 
	receipt_payload BLOB, 
	prepared_content TEXT, 
	diagnostics_payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (record_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_context_prepare_status CHECK (status IN ('ready', 'empty', 'failed', 'cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_context_prepare_duration CHECK (duration_ms >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_context_prepare_budget CHECK (requested_max_bytes >= 512 AND requested_max_bytes <= 32768), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_context_prepare_content_bytes CHECK (content_bytes IS NULL OR content_bytes >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_context_prepare_selected_count CHECK (selected_count IS NULL OR selected_count >= 0)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_context_prepare_scope_finished ON pc_context_prepare_diagnostics (scope_id, finished_at, record_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_context_prepare_scope_status_finished ON pc_context_prepare_diagnostics (scope_id, status, finished_at, record_id)
